26: /// If we find an ignored suffix on the file name, e.g. '~', we strip it and
27: /// then try again without it.
28: pub fn try_with_stripped_suffix<T, F>(file_name: &OsStr, func: F) -> Result<Option<T>>

30:     F: Fn(&OsStr) -> Result<Option<T>>,
31: {

33:     if let Some(file_str) = Path::new(file_name).to_str() {
34:         for suffix in &IGNORED_SUFFIXES {
35:             if let Some(stripped_filename) = file_str.strip_suffix(suffix) {
36:                 from_stripped = func(OsStr::new(stripped_filename))?;
37:                 break;
38:             }
